{{Top|leg}}
'''Team 19''' was an [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] unit attached to the [[14th Roving Line]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was led by [[Miko Beski]]. Team 19 was made up of [[Marines (SpecForce)|SpaceOps]] personnel, [[Heavy Weapons Specialists|heavy weapons specialists]] and a [[Technicians/Legends|technical squad]] consisting of [[Technicians/Legends#Drivers.2FPilots|transportation]], [[Technicians/Legends#Technicians.2FEngineers.2FMedics|medical]] and [[Technicians/Legends#Scanner-Communications_Operators scan-com specialists|Scanner Communications Operators scan-com specialists]]. It acted as the 14th Roving Lines main boarding party and [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] assault force. An [[Aegis-class Combat Shuttle|Aegis combat shuttle]] served Team 19 on its missions.<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>

Members of Team 19 included [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Miko Beski, Lieutenant [[Whumparrin]], and [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-7NO]].<ref name="ROE" />
